	# Loaded by the victory settlement. The pre-war tree is shared history, so

	shared_focus = NAM_recognition

	# Etatist course: the opener, the two state models and their wings. Every
	# card sits relative to NAM_law_after_war (36,1 on the post-war grid).

	# District course: the charter, the opening pair, the federation wing and the
	# spine to the southern offensive. Cells are relative to law_after_war (36,1).

	# Plan or trusts: the industrial fork under the basin card and its two
	# follow-ups, rejoined by the Kadir embassy on the axis.

	# District course, service lane: the rescue college, the militia or relief
	# fork, the reserve and the districts' university.

	# Pragmatic course: the axis, the two opening sides and their wings, the
	# guarantee fork and the hub. Positions are relative to NAM_law_after_war
	# (36,1 of the post-war grid); the path mirrors about its column.

	# Republic wing: city works and the municipal bonds, joined by the commonwealth.

	# Directorate wing: the export clearing and licensed assembly, joined by the
	# machine-tool contracts.

	# The wings rejoin at the register.

	# Guarantee fork: who stands behind a contract, the treasury or private houses.

	# Body under the embassy: the export lane on the left, the constitution on
	# the axis and the state works lane on the right.

	# Industry lane: repair depots, the testing office, the port polytechnic
	# (the path's research-slot keeper) and the licence or design fork.

	# District course, municipal lane: rural power, the city land or residents'
	# councils fork, the water boards and the district workshops.

	# Labour duty or state insurance, their follow-ups and the hub that closes
	# the course before the southern campaign.

	# District course, union wing: the oil fund, the artel congress and the
	# district fair.

	# Sea lane: insured caravans, the port agreement and the freight office,
	# the sea or land supply fork and the warehouse receipts.

}

			unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_pw_district_schools
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_pw_district_schools_unlock_tt

						tooltip = NAM_field_repair_trained_focus_condition_not_met_tt

					}
				}
				unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_project_repair_wells
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_rescue_college_service_tt
			}
			else = { custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_rescue_college_service_tt }

				type = support_equipment

			ADISCORD_reform_society_development = yes
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 5 }
	}

shared_focus = {
		id = NAM_relief_reserves
		relative_position_id = NAM_law_after_war
		x = -6
		y = 12
		icon = GFX_focus_NAM_relief_reserves
		allow_branch = { NAM_prewar_district_mandate = yes }
		cost = 2
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY FOCUS_FILTER_WAR_SUPPORT }
		prerequisite = {
			focus = NAM_district_militia
			focus = NAM_relief_register
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_pw_operable_tt
				NAM_pw_operable = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_prewar_district_mandate_tt
				NAM_prewar_district_mandate = yes
			}
		}
		cancel_if_invalid = yes
		continue_if_invalid = no
		completion_reward = {
			# The silo brings its own shared slot; owner and controller are checked
			# on the completion day, and the treasury pays when the state is lost.
			690 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
					}
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
					add_building_construction = {
						type = fuel_silo
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add_fuel = 35000
			if = {
				limit = { has_completed_focus = NAM_district_militia }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = infantry_equipment
					amount = 6000
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = support_equipment
					amount = 200
					producer = NAM
				}
			}
			add_war_support = 0.05
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_relief_reserves_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							690 = {
								is_owned_by = ROOT
								is_controlled_by = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 5 }
	}

							building = industrial_complex
							size = 1

				}

				add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
					type = motorized_equipment
					amount = 250
					producer = NAM

			}
			else = {

			}
